_doc: Grader-gap hidden-spec (DEF-RET / solver-catches mode). This file lives in the harness tree and is NEVER copied into a run directory, so the discriminating post is withheld from the agent by construction (the blindness fix that postmortem-010 had to retrofit, applied at fixture-design time). evaluate_run.py resolves it by experiment_id at grade time, injects each `post` onto the named function in a graded COPY of the agent solution, and runs `llmll verify <copy> --strict-verified-core` (fixpoint mode). Outcome polarity is INVERTED for a solver-catches benchmark: refuted = the solver caught the planted bug (success); verified = a clean impl (no bug to catch); vacuous (fallback / fixpoint could not run) = non-catch, never a ceiling (F-B0-2 non-vacuity gate). NOTE: for a true grader-gap fixture (portfolio P3/P4) the experiment markdown must NOT mandate this post in the agent-visible problem.md — the agent authors the body blind and the harness supplies the post here. For 005 this demonstrates the mechanism using the range post the experiment currently mandates.
